# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church is a battle cry for every man who claims the name of Christ. Notice the progression: watchfulness comes first. A soldier who isn't alert is a soldier who falls. Before you can stand firm, you must know where the enemy is attacking—your eyes, your temper, your tongue, your time. Then comes the standing. Not drifting, not wavering, not negotiating with temptation—standing firm in the faith once delivered to the saints.

"Act like men" is not a call to swagger but to courage. It means taking responsibility when it's easier to pass the buck, speaking truth when silence is safer, and leading your family in prayer when you feel unqualified. And "be strong"—not in your own grit, but in the Lord and the power of His might. Strength for the Christian man is borrowed strength, supplied daily through Scripture, prayer, and brotherhood.

The storm will come. The question is whether you'll be found standing when it does. Today, fix your feet on the Rock.
## Daily Challenge
Do 30 pushups—10 while thanking God for His watchful care, 10 while confessing where you've drifted, and 10 while asking for strength to stand firm today.
